At temperature 0.25 on CNN/DailyMail, **DPO gets a GPT-4 win rate of 0.31 against the ground truth, and PPO gets 0.23** (Table 1, page 9).

These are out-of-distribution results. The policies were trained on Reddit TL;DR summarization and then tested on news articles from the CNN/DailyMail test split. Temperatures 0 and 0.25 were used because they were the best sampling temperatures from TL;DR (page 9). The paper concludes that DPO still beats PPO by a significant margin on this new distribution (page 9).
